annotations.title: Rebuild your app as a free 10-page interactive preview

description: Free 10-page interactive preview (core routes first); full site and add-ons unlock at checkout. Up to 10 pages (index plus primary navigation routes by default, or pages the owner picks) are rebuilt from the uploaded app file as React pages on sample data, then checked and scored automatically. Free, up to 5 previews per app. Nothing in the owner's app changes and nothing is charged. Typically takes ~30 to 90 seconds: call nc_preview_status to follow it. Asking again for the same job returns the build that is already running.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded and planned (nc_compile_plan).

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

pages.description: Names of up to 10 pages, as listed by nc_compile_plan with detail full. Leave out to compile the 10 highest-priority core routes first.
